C1225.title: China's Three Major Telecoms Accused of Overcharging Loyal Users with Inferior Plans
C1225.summary: A wave of user complaints alleges that China's three major telecom operators are engaging in price discrimination against long-time subscribers, who are locked into higher-priced plans with fewer benefits while new customers enjoy cheaper, high-data packages.
